reviews.text: We have had Pretty Pools service our pool for the last two years. They are very nice and kind people, and they are also super friendly with our dogs. Thanks to Alex and the team!
reviews.author: Nok Koster

reviews.text: We recently used Pretty pools as they were highly recommended.  They did a great job however I was disappointed when they charged us an additional fee for having to come back the next day to fix the issue due to not having a part in their truck.  When we called we told them the problem so why wouldn’t they bring what was needed to fix the issue they thought it was?  Charging an additional fee to have to come back out because a part wasn’t on the truck is unacceptable.  25 minutes of work cost us $250.  So disappointing, we won’t be using them again
reviews.author: Teresa Johnson

reviews.text: The bearings in my 12 year old Pentair Intelliflow pump were going out and I did not want an issue if we hand anouther deep freeze.  I also had an issue with air getting in the line.  I thought about replacing the unit myself, but I liked the idea of the 3 year warranty and the plumbing was very cramped.  I was happy when a sharp service tech showed up, quickly had my new pump up and going and also solved the air leak.  The new install is better then the old because the pump is now flat on the pad and not lifted up as before.  I would highly recommend Pretty Pools.
reviews.author: Kris Hanchette

reviews.text: Pretty Pools Flower Mound is absolutely my go-to for all things pool maintenance! I recently had them replace a faulty bubbler light, and during the process, they uncovered a serious issue with the original wiring of my pool—it wasn’t just incorrect, it was unsafe! But no worries, the amazing General Manager, Nick Collins, personally stepped in to take charge of the project. He made sure every detail was perfect, and I was thrilled with the outcome! I couldn’t be happier with the exceptional work and top-notch service these guys consistently deliver. They’re simply the best!
reviews.author: Scott Moberly

reviews.text: Pretty Pools is a great company and we will continue using their services. Stacy and Melissa have been incredibly responsive and helpful via email and phone. The techs have explained to me how the system works, answered my questions when I have concerns, and are just super nice and respectful of my property. The pool always looks great after they service it and continues looking great until the next service date. Their service prices are very reasonable, and I researched a bunch of companies before hiring them. And having someone with expertise come out regularly gives me peace of mind that any problem that may arise will be quickly identified. They are also flexible and accommodating to how often we've wanted service. I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Heather Rhea

reviews.text: Service Oriented, Proactive, Professional.  We had Pretty Pools install some new pool equipment and automation recently and could not be happier with the outcome from Marc and his team.  From the assistance and education with the purchase, to the install day, to the post install support the service was excellent.  Nick did a very thorough install which looked very clean and you can tell he takes pride in his final work product.  Additionally, I was impressed with the proactive approach they took to diagnosing and fixing our pool cleaner.  They spun through 5-6 possible issues and found 2 key issues that they fixed quickly.  This is the kind of company you appreciate working with.
reviews.author: Aaron Garinger

reviews.text: Pretty Pools has been servicing my pool for several years now. They are by far the best providers we’ve had. They show up consistently and my pool is maintained as promised. I don’t have to worry about anything. When something occurs with equipment after hours I email and it’s responded to.  My technician Zach is always on top of things!
reviews.author: cassandra shimp

reviews.text: The people at Pretty Pools in Flower Mound TX are great people to work with.  From the owners to the staff, I have had zero problems with anyone.  The owners go out of their way to make sure the customer is happy and satisfied with the work of the entire team.  They are very responsive to all questions and concerns.  When I first started my pool, Marc and team took care of the chemical imbalance that I could never get right.  They were so good, I eventually had them servicing the pool weekly.  When I get my next pool, they will be the team for me to call.  8 Months and counting.
reviews.author: Jimmy Wilson
